titulo: PILAR-2b: the biogas map of São Paulo (en-GB)

falas.texto: It's hidden in waste: in sugarcane, in manure, in city rubbish… spread across 645 municipalities.
falas.fala: It's hidden in waste: in sugarcane, in manure, in city rubbish… spread across six hundred and forty-five municipalities.

falas.texto: To find that potential, CP2B created PILAR-2b.
falas.fala: To find that potential, C-P-two-B created Pilar two-B.

falas.texto: An online platform that brings together data from farming, livestock and cities…
…and calculates how much biogas each municipality could produce.
Just choose the type of waste, click on your city… and see the result straight away.
All based on science: the sources and methods are there for everyone to see.
So public managers, companies and researchers can find where it's worth investing in renewable energy.
PILAR-2b: the biogas map of São Paulo. Take a look and explore!
falas.fala: Pilar two-B: the biogas map of São Paulo. Take a look and explore!
